summary: Rabbi Soffer analyzes the Mishna in Masekhet Arachin regarding the calculation of lunar years, the number of tekiot in the Bet HaMikdash, and the use of musical instruments in the service. He explores the Gemara's discussion on why certain instruments were kept in their original state despite damage, emphasizing the value of tradition over modern improvements.
